question.pt: Como fazer parceria com empresas moçambicanas?
question.en: How do I partner with Mozambican companies?
question.fr: Comment s'associer à des sociétés mozambicaines ?

body.pt:
Para fornecer ao sector petrolífero, uma empresa estrangeira deve, em regra, associar-se a uma empresa moçambicana [ref:lei-21-2014]. A parceria deve ser real e demonstrável, e não apenas formal.

Formas habituais:

- Sociedade conjunta registada em Moçambique, com participação moçambicana ({{LOCAL_PARTNER_MIN_SHARE}}) [ref:dl-1-2022].
- Consórcio ou acordo de subcontratação, com repartição clara de trabalhos e responsabilidades.
- Transferência de conhecimento e formação, documentadas.
- Diligência prévia ao parceiro: registo comercial, situação fiscal, capacidade técnica e beneficiários efectivos.
body.en:
To supply the oil and gas sector, a foreign company should, as a rule, partner with a Mozambican company [ref:lei-21-2014]. The partnership must be real and demonstrable, not merely formal.

Common structures:

- A joint venture company registered in Mozambique, with Mozambican participation ({{LOCAL_PARTNER_MIN_SHARE}}) [ref:dl-1-2022].
- A consortium or subcontracting agreement, with a clear split of work and responsibilities.
- Documented knowledge transfer and training.
- Due diligence on the partner: commercial registration, tax position, technical capacity and beneficial owners.
body.fr:
Pour fournir le secteur pétrolier, une société étrangère doit en principe s'associer à une société mozambicaine [ref:lei-21-2014]. Le partenariat doit être réel et démontrable, et non purement formel.

Formes courantes :

- Société commune immatriculée au Mozambique, avec participation mozambicaine ({{LOCAL_PARTNER_MIN_SHARE}}) [ref:dl-1-2022].
- Consortium ou contrat de sous-traitance, avec une répartition claire des travaux et des responsabilités.
- Transfert de compétences et formation documentés.
- Due diligence sur le partenaire : immatriculation, situation fiscale, capacité technique et bénéficiaires effectifs.

whenToTalk.pt: Antes de assinar um acordo de parceria: a Tax Advisory faz a diligência prévia ao parceiro e estrutura a sociedade ou o consórcio.
whenToTalk.en: Before signing a partnership agreement: Tax Advisory carries out due diligence on the partner and structures the company or consortium.
whenToTalk.fr: Avant de signer un accord de partenariat : Tax Advisory réalise la due diligence du partenaire et structure la société ou le consortium.

question.pt: Como participar nos projectos de GNL em Cabo Delgado?
question.en: How can I take part in the LNG projects in Cabo Delgado?
question.fr: Comment participer aux projets de GNL au Cabo Delgado ?

body.pt:
Os projectos de gás natural liquefeito (GNL) da bacia do Rovuma, em Cabo Delgado, contratam através de concursos geridos pelas concessionárias e pelos empreiteiros principais, com regras de conteúdo local [ref:lei-21-2014]. Para a maioria dos fornecedores, o acesso faz-se pela cadeia de subcontratação.

O que preparar:

- Registo como fornecedor junto das concessionárias e dos empreiteiros principais.
- Parceria com empresas moçambicanas e plano de emprego e formação local.
- Certificações de qualidade, saúde, segurança e ambiente exigidas nos concursos.
- Planeamento de logística e segurança adequado às condições da província.
- Enquadramento no Decreto n.º 70/2017, instrumento referido na base jurídica da Tax Advisory; âmbito a confirmar ({{SCOPE_DEC_70_2017}}) [ref:dec-70-2017].
body.en:
The liquefied natural gas (LNG) projects in the Rovuma basin, Cabo Delgado, procure through tenders run by the concessionaires and the main contractors, subject to local content rules [ref:lei-21-2014]. For most suppliers, access is through the subcontracting chain.

What to prepare:

- Registration as a supplier with the concessionaires and the main contractors.
- A partnership with Mozambican companies and a local employment and training plan.
- The quality, health, safety and environmental certifications required in tenders.
- Logistics and security planning suited to conditions in the province.
- The position under Decree 70/2017, instrument cited in Tax Advisory's legal basis; scope to be confirmed ({{SCOPE_DEC_70_2017}}) [ref:dec-70-2017].
body.fr:
Les projets de gaz naturel liquéfié (GNL) du bassin du Rovuma, au Cabo Delgado, passent leurs marchés par des appels d'offres gérés par les concessionnaires et les entrepreneurs principaux, sous des règles de contenu local [ref:lei-21-2014]. Pour la plupart des fournisseurs, l'accès passe par la chaîne de sous-traitance.

À préparer :

- Enregistrement comme fournisseur auprès des concessionnaires et des entrepreneurs principaux.
- Partenariat avec des sociétés mozambicaines et plan d'emploi et de formation locale.
- Certifications qualité, santé, sécurité et environnement exigées dans les appels d'offres.
- Planification logistique et sécuritaire adaptée aux conditions de la province.
- Situation au regard du décret n° 70/2017, instrument cité dans la base juridique de Tax Advisory ; portée à confirmer ({{SCOPE_DEC_70_2017}}) [ref:dec-70-2017].

whenToTalk.pt: Antes de investir para servir os projectos de GNL: a Tax Advisory avalia o enquadramento de conteúdo local, a estrutura com parceiro e os riscos contratuais.
whenToTalk.en: Before investing to serve the LNG projects: Tax Advisory assesses the local content position, the partner structure and the contractual risks.
whenToTalk.fr: Avant d'investir pour servir les projets de GNL : Tax Advisory évalue le cadre de contenu local, la structure avec partenaire et les risques contractuels.

question.pt: Como registar a empresa como fornecedora no sector do petróleo e gás?
question.en: How do I register my company as an oil and gas supplier?
question.fr: Comment enregistrer ma société comme fournisseur du secteur pétrolier et gazier ?

body.pt:
O registo como fornecedor faz-se junto das concessionárias e dos empreiteiros principais, normalmente em plataformas próprias de qualificação, e exige uma empresa regularmente constituída e em dia com as obrigações fiscais e contributivas [ref:lei-21-2014].

Documentos e requisitos habituais:

- Certidão de registo comercial e NUIT [ref:dl-1-2022].
- Alvará ou licença da actividade [ref:dec-41-2026].
- Certidões de quitação fiscal e do INSS [ref:inss].
- Comprovativo da estrutura accionista e, quando aplicável, da participação moçambicana.
- Certificações técnicas e de saúde, segurança e ambiente, e enquadramento no Decreto n.º 70/2017, instrumento referido na base jurídica da Tax Advisory; âmbito a confirmar ({{SCOPE_DEC_70_2017}}) [ref:dec-70-2017].

{{^ctx}}Manter estas certidões válidas é essencial: uma certidão caducada pode excluir a empresa de um concurso.{{/ctx}}
body.en:
Supplier registration is done with the concessionaires and the main contractors, usually on their own qualification platforms, and requires a duly incorporated company that is up to date with its tax and social security obligations [ref:lei-21-2014].

Usual documents and requirements:

- Commercial registration certificate and NUIT (tax number) [ref:dl-1-2022].
- Business permit or activity licence [ref:dec-41-2026].
- Tax and INSS clearance certificates [ref:inss].
- Evidence of the shareholding structure and, where relevant, of Mozambican participation.
- Technical and health, safety and environmental certifications, and the position under Decree 70/2017, instrument cited in Tax Advisory's legal basis; scope to be confirmed ({{SCOPE_DEC_70_2017}}) [ref:dec-70-2017].

{{^ctx}}Keeping these certificates valid is essential: an expired certificate can exclude the company from a tender.{{/ctx}}
body.fr:
L'enregistrement comme fournisseur se fait auprès des concessionnaires et des entrepreneurs principaux, généralement sur leurs propres plateformes de qualification, et exige une société régulièrement constituée et à jour de ses obligations fiscales et sociales [ref:lei-21-2014].

Documents et conditions habituels :

- Certificat d'immatriculation et NUIT (numéro fiscal) [ref:dl-1-2022].
- Alvará (autorisation d'exercer) ou licence d'activité [ref:dec-41-2026].
- Attestations de régularité fiscale et INSS [ref:inss].
- Justificatif de la structure de l'actionnariat et, le cas échéant, de la participation mozambicaine.
- Certifications techniques et santé, sécurité et environnement, et situation au regard du décret n° 70/2017, instrument cité dans la base juridique de Tax Advisory ; portée à confirmer ({{SCOPE_DEC_70_2017}}) [ref:dec-70-2017].

{{^ctx}}Maintenir ces attestations à jour est essentiel : une attestation expirée peut exclure la société d'un appel d'offres.{{/ctx}}

whenToTalk.en: Before starting registration on a supplier platform: Tax Advisory gathers and checks the certificates and corporate documents.
whenToTalk.fr: Avant de commencer l'enregistrement sur une plateforme fournisseurs : Tax Advisory rassemble et vérifie les attestations et les documents sociaux.
